entry.author: Antarctica New Zealand
entry.summary:
POV: Doing a marathon in Antarctica.

Over 20 Scott Base personnel joined their McMurdo peers to run, ski and bike the McMurdo Marathon course last month. This curious Emperor penguin wanted to get amongst the action!

Antarctica New Zealand’s Environmental Code of Conduct states wildlife get the right of way and people should stay 10m away from animals unless they come to you. Luckily there was plenty of space to go around the penguin.

🎥 Jean-Christophe Varnier
